zh-TW.title: 每週站會摘要
zh-TW.text:
請將以下會議筆記整理成精簡的每週站會更新，重點包含：已完成事項、進行中事項，以及目前的阻礙。請控制在 150 字內。

[請在此貼上會議筆記]

en.title: Weekly Standup Summary
en.text:
Summarize the following meeting notes into a concise weekly standup update. Focus on: what was accomplished, what is in progress, and any blockers. Keep it under 150 words.

[Paste meeting notes here]

zh-TW.title: 除錯助手
zh-TW.text:
以下程式碼產生了非預期的結果。請幫我找出 bug、說明原因，並提供修正後的版本與簡短解釋。

語言：[language]
程式碼：
[請在此貼上程式碼]

預期行為：
實際行為：

en.title: Debug Helper
en.text:
I have the following code that is producing an unexpected result. Please identify the bug, explain why it occurs, and provide a corrected version with a brief explanation.

Language: [language]
Code:
[paste code here]

Expected behavior:
Actual behavior:

zh-TW.title: 短篇故事開頭
zh-TW.text:
請根據以下元素，寫出一篇短篇故事的開場段落：
- 類型：[genre]
- 場景：[setting]
- 主角：[brief description]
- 開場氛圍：[例如：神祕、充滿希望、緊張]

請描寫得生動，並在段落結尾留下能吸引讀者繼續看的懸念。

en.title: Short Story Starter
en.text:
Write the opening paragraph of a short story with the following elements:
- Genre: [genre]
- Setting: [setting]
- Main character: [brief description]
- Opening mood: [e.g. mysterious, hopeful, tense]

Make it vivid and end the paragraph on a hook that draws the reader in.

zh-TW.title: 概念白話解釋
zh-TW.text: 請把 [topic] 這個概念解釋給一位好奇的 10 歲小朋友聽。請用生活化的比喻、避免術語，並將說明控制在 200 字內。

en.title: Concept Explainer (ELI5)
en.text: Explain the concept of [topic] as if I were a curious 10-year-old. Use a simple analogy from everyday life, avoid jargon, and keep the explanation under 200 words.

zh-TW.title: 程式碼審查請求
zh-TW.text:
請審查以下程式碼，並針對這些面向提供回饋：
1. 程式碼品質與可讀性
2. 潛在 bug 或邊界情況
3. 效能改善建議
4. 安全性疑慮
5. 最佳實務

[請在此貼上程式碼]

en.title: Code Review Request
en.text:
Please review the following code and provide feedback on:
1. Code quality and readability
2. Potential bugs or edge cases
3. Performance improvements
4. Security concerns
5. Best practices

[paste code here]

zh-TW.title: 專業 Email 草稿
zh-TW.text:
請根據以下資訊撰寫一封專業電子郵件：
- 目的：[purpose]
- 收件者：[who/role]
- 需涵蓋重點：[bullet points]
- 語氣：[正式 / 親切 / 緊急]
- 期望結果：[希望對方採取的行動]

內容請保持精簡清楚。

en.title: Email Draft
en.text:
Write a professional email with the following details:
- Purpose: [purpose]
- Recipient: [who/role]
- Key points to cover: [bullet points]
- Tone: [formal / friendly / urgent]
- Desired outcome: [what you want them to do]

Keep it concise and clear.
